instruction.text: Are there any mistakes in this sentence?

atoms.a: Grace isn’t happy with her mark on her maths test.
Jaden shoul’dve tidied his room before his friends arrived.
atoms.sound: Jaden should’ve tidied his room before his friends arrived.

b: ++The apostrophe is in the wrong place in the contraction.
Contractions shouldn’t be used in formal writing.

instruction.text: Rewrite the sentence with the correct contraction.

atoms.b: Jaden ((should’ve should’ve)) tidied his room before his friends arrived.

b: The apostrophe is in the wrong place in the contraction.

end.text: Contractions are used in informal writing to make it easier to read and sound more casual. It should not be used in formal writing, like job application letters.
